resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Structs[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Go does not support [b]classes[/b]. Instead, it has [b]structs[/b].
Structs are collections of fields that allow you to group data together.

For example, let's make a struct to store the data of Contacts:[code format="go" ]type Contact struct {
  name string
  age  int
} [/code]
Our [b]Contact[/b] struct has two fields, a string and an integer.

Now, we can create a new Contact using the following syntax:
[code format="go" ]x := Contact{"James", 42}[/code][b]x[/b] is now a structs that is initialized with the data provided in the curly braces.
[note]We can also provide the names of the fields when creating a new struct.
For example: 
[b]x := Contact{name: "James", age: 42}[/b]
This makes it easier to read the code.[/note]

resolved.title: 员工管理
resolved.problem_statement_md:
请编写一个员工管理系统。
每个**员工**(Employee)有以下字段：
- **姓名**: `name`
- **年龄**: `age`
- **职位**: `position`
- **工资**: `salary`

示例代码已创建一个成员，并输出相关数据。

现在，需要定义`Employee`结构体来完成该程序，这样`main()`中的代码就能预期执行。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Employee Management[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are building an Employee Management system.
Each [b]Employee[/b] has the following fields: [b]name[/b], [b]age[/b], [b]position[/b], and [b]salary[/b].

The given code creates an Employee with the provided values and generates output based on the data.
Complete the program by defining the Employee struct with the correct fields, so that the code in [b]main[/b]() works as expected. 
[note]Make sure to use the correct data types for the struct fields.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 确保结构字段使用正确的数据类型。

code_templates.template:
package main
import "fmt"


func main() {
    e1 := Employee{"James", 42, "Manager", 0}

    var x float32
    fmt.Scanln(&x)
    e1.salary = x
    
    fmt.Println("========")
    fmt.Println(e1.name + "(" + e1.position + ")")
    fmt.Println(e1.age)
    fmt.Println(e1.salary)
    fmt.Println("========")
}
code_templates.solution_code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
    e1 := Employee{"James", 42, "Manager", 0}
    var x float32
    fmt.Scanln(&x)
    e1.salary = x
    fmt.Println("========")
    fmt.Println(e1.name + "(" + e1.position + ")")
    fmt.Println(e1.age)
    fmt.Println(e1.salary)
    fmt.Println("========")
}
type Employee struct{
	name string
	age int
	position string
	salary float32
}
